tether.selection: Smallest suitable housing with published dimensions found in this comparison; not a claim that it is the world's smallest.
tether.modelNotes: Published housing envelope, cable diameter and travel. Surface details, adapter saddles and fixture cavities are modeled design proposals, not manufacturer CAD. The reel takes up cable slack; it is not sized to hoist the samples. Sample thicknesses are unchanged.
tether.mounting: Parallel to the inclined carrier slots, beneath each board; outlet points toward the slot.
